coordinate_convention: OpenCV +x right, +y down, +z forward; integer pixel centres; nearest floor(u+0.5), half-open bounds

depth_residual_max.meaning: Maximum of the comparable relative depth residuals.

n_colour_conflict.meaning: Supported original source versus target-prediction RGB MAE >0.10.

n_comparable.meaning: In frame, valid source and target opacities, positive validated source and target Z.

n_conflict.meaning: Number of sources with either a depth conflict or a colour conflict.

n_depth_conflict.meaning: Comparable with both opacities >=0.5 and relative depth residual >0.10.

n_in_frame.meaning: Positive projected Z and nearest integer-centre pixel in the source frame.

n_sources.meaning: Number of source RGB frames allowed for this score.

n_supported.meaning: Comparable with both opacities >=0.5 and relative depth residual <=0.10.

self_render_mae_mean.meaning: Mean original versus self-render source colour MAE among comparable finite source renders.

source_alpha_mean.meaning: Mean source opacity among comparable samples.

source_pair_mae_max.meaning: Maximum channel MAE between any two supported original source colours.

target_local_depth_range.meaning: Truncated 3x3 positive Z range divided by centre Z; at least 3 valid samples.

target_local_rgb_mae.meaning: Truncated 3x3 mean channel MAE to centre; at least 3 valid samples.

target_source_mae_mean.meaning: Mean supported target-prediction versus original-source channel MAE.

target_source_mae_min.meaning: Minimum supported target-prediction versus original-source channel MAE.

target_source_mae_range.meaning: Max minus min among at least two supported finite target/source colour residuals.

view_angle_mean.meaning: Mean angle between source and target observation rays among comparable sources.

missing_value: IEEE NaN in numeric column; 1 in its missing indicator
neighbourhood: 3x3 includes centre and truncates at image boundaries
scoreable: verified ED, finite valid target RGB, alpha and positive Z, and at least one comparable source
source_order: sort by original source ID, reduce finite values in float64, emit float32
source_sampling: original source RGB8 converted to float32 /255; nearest integer pixel; self-render from same reconstruction
unavailable_source_render: still counts as provided and can be in frame, cannot be comparable
unsupported_domains: one-source scores are extrapolation from all-source M2/M4 training; no evidence means unknown
